annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on medical devices, and amending Directive 2001/83/EC, Regulation (EC) No 178/2002 and Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on medical devices, and amending Directive 2001/83/EC, Regulation (EC) No 178/2002 and Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009
annotation.summary_en: European Commission 2012 proposal for a Regulation replacing the EU medical device directives. It strengthens notified body oversight, risk-class-based conformity assessment, traceability (UDI), the Eudamed database, clinical investigation rules, vigilance and market surveillance. It is the predecessor of the MDR and has no AI-specific provisions; it covers stand-alone software only incidentally.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four risk classes with conformity assessment proportionate to risk; notified body involvement mandatory for classes IIa, IIb and III
Stricter designation and monitoring of notified bodies, with joint assessments and unannounced inspections
Unique Device Identification and central Eudamed database for transparency and traceability
Clinical investigation rules and EU vigilance portal for serious incident reporting
Creation of the Medical Device Coordination Group; repeals Directives 90/385/EEC and 93/42/EEC
